name: Sotetsu Holdings, Inc.
summary: Sotetsu Holdings, Inc. provides transportation services in Japan. It offers railway and bus transport services. The company also operates supermarkets under the Sotetsu Rosen name, convenience stores under Sotetsu Station Retail; condominiums and detached houses under Gracia series; consulting services for purchasing, selling, and owning commercial real estate; renovated commercial properties; hotels under Sotetsu FRESA INN, and Sotetsu Hotels names. In addition, it provides building management and maintenance; non-life insurance agency services; facility maintenance; district heating and cooling; home renovation; job creation; insurance; and re-employment after retirement services.
